# Affy550K Setup

The core genome-wide data in FHS is provided as part of the SNP Health Association Resource (SHARe) substudy. Genotyping was performed using the Affymetrix500K mapping array (FHS accession: `phg000004.v9`) and the supplemental "HuGeneFocused" Affymetrix50K array (FHS accession: `phg000006.v9`). These arrays are somewhat outdated; the `PLINK` binary files released with the study version used here (`phs000007.v31.p11`) are mapped to the NCBI36 human genome assembly with variants assigned to SSIDs rather than RSIDs. A variety of options, such as the `Ensembl` Crossmap tool, enable liftover to more recent assemblies. The FHS sample is divided into two consent groups, FCoh1 ($n = 6,954$) and FCoh2 ($n = 2,270$). Merging across array sets and subject consent groups provides the raw Affy550K/full sample `PLINK` sets. 



## Merge Arrays/Samples

```{bash}
## Merge plink file sets across the four array/consent group pairs:
## affy500k_c1, affy500k_c2, affy50k_c1, and affy50k_c2
plink1.9 \
  --bfile affy500K_c1 \
  --merge-list affy_names.txt \
  --make-bed \
  --out affy550K_raw
```

## Update PLINK Files with NCBI36 to GRCh37 Map

```{r}
## Map created using ensembl liftover tool
FHS_NCBI36.to.GRCh37 <- read.table("H.grch37_ensembl/Created_Maps/FHS_NCBI36.to.GRCh37.txt", header = T)
```

```{bash}
MAP=FHS_NCBI36.to.GRCh37.txt
## Use to create NCBI36 PLINK set with RSIDs and valid position info
awk 'BEGIN{OFS ="\t"} NR >1 {print $8}' $MAP > ssid.B36_extract.txt
awk 'BEGIN{OFS ="\t"} NR >1 {print $8,$7}' $MAP > ssid.B36_to_rsid.B36.txt

## Use to create GRCh37 PLINK set with updated RSIDs and position info
awk 'BEGIN{OFS ="\t"} NR >1 {print $7,$9}' $MAP > rsid.B36_to_rsid.B37.txt
awk 'BEGIN{OFS ="\t"} NR >1 {print $9,$5}' $MAP > chr.B36_to_chr.B37.txt
awk 'BEGIN{OFS ="\t"} NR >1 {print $9,$6}' $MAP > pos.B36_to_pos.B37.txt
```

```{bash}
## Extract SSIDs
plink1.9 \
  --bfile Affy_Orig/affy550K_raw \
  --extract NCBI36_to_GRCh37_Files/ssid.B36_extract.txt \
  --make-bed \
  --out Affy_Orig/Affy550K_ssid.B36_extract

## Convert SSIDs to B36 RSIDs
plink1.9 \
  --bfile Affy_Orig/Affy550K_ssid.B36_extract \
  --update-name NCBI36_to_GRCh37_Files/ssid.B36_to_rsid.B36.txt \
  --make-bed \
  --out Affy_Orig/Affy550K_rsid.B36
  
## Convert B36 RSIDs to B37 RSIDs
plink1.9 \
  --bfile Affy_Orig/Affy550K_rsid.B36 \
  --update-name NCBI36_to_GRCh37_Files/rsid.B36_to_rsid.B37.txt \
  --make-bed \
  --out Affy_GRCh37/Affy550K_rsid.B37

## Update B37 chromosome and position values
plink1.9 \
  --bfile Affy_GRCh37/Affy550K_rsid.B37 \
  --update-chr NCBI36_to_GRCh37_Files/chr.B36_to_chr.B37.txt \
  --update-map NCBI36_to_GRCh37_Files/pos.B36_to_pos.B37.txt \
  --make-bed \
  --out Affy_GRCh37/Affy550K_GRCh37_raw
```

## Baseline QC

```{bash}
## Sample: 9,260 -> 8,499
## Variants: 534,771 -> 396,713
~/plink1.9/plink \
  --bfile Affy550K_GRCh37_raw \
  --maf 0.01 \
  --hwe 0.000001 \
  --geno 0.03 \
  --nonfounders \
  --mind 0.03 \
  --make-bed \
  --out Affy550K_qc1
```
